dedupe_keys.name: filaire du graphe routier du departement de la mayenne

description: Filaire du graphe routier du département de la Mayenne is a dataset listed in data.lamayenne.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de la Mayenne. Tronçons du graphe routier et de la Ligne Grande Vitesse (LGV) utilisés comme référentiel pour toutes les données du système d'information routière du département de La Mayenne. Coverage: Mayenne. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are autoroute, hierarchie, lgv, mayenne, referentiel, reseau. The portal shows 1,014 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lamayenne-fr-portal.
